title: Implement ObservationProcessor and trust boundary handling
purpose: Convert tool output and external content into structured observations without letting untrusted text trigger direct actions.
scope: Define observation trust labels: local-system, sandboxed-tool, external-untrusted, model-summary, operator-approved.
Sanitize and summarize untrusted observations through ModelBroker or deterministic sanitizer.
Extract policy-relevant flags such as suggested command, secret-like content, external URL, credential request, or privilege escalation request.
Prevent observations from adding PlanSteps directly; they can only inform Planner replanning through validation and policy gates.
Record observation summaries and redaction status in RunStore and AuditJournal.
Add explicit handling for prompt injection and observation injection fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: External content is marked untrusted by default.
Observation text that asks the agent to run commands cannot create a direct tool call.
Secret-like output is redacted before memory or model context.
Policy-relevant flags are visible in audit and run-state projection.
Replanning after observation still goes through Planner validation and PolicyEvaluator.
verification: Feed prompt injection fixtures and confirm no EffectPrepared is emitted.
Feed secret-like output and inspect redaction.
Confirm audit entries include trust labels and flags.
risk_notes: Tool output is part of the attack surface; treating it as instructions would break the OS boundary.
